title: Buccal Fat Removal: How much is too much?
caption:
Will buccal fat removal make your face look too hollow? Not if it’s done carefully. Many patients ask for reduction in cheek fullness, but it’s important to preserve some buccal fat for both function and aesthetics. Since this fat extends up into the temple, over-removal can lead to unwanted volume loss in other areas. That’s why a conservative approach is key, targeting just the right amount for a refined, natural result without compromising facial harmony.

#buccalfat #buccalfatpadremoval #buc

It not only exists here, but extends up into the temple. So, if you actually took out too much buccal fat, you would actually reduce the amount of fat or fullness that you have in your temple.
